purpose: Executable checks of the integer overlap predicate, unreduced endpoint values and bounded neighbor enumeration against the earlier rational definitions. Kernel proofs establish all-size correctness; these executions establish no tape-time or expander-existence bound.
checks: all2100 source endpoints and images agree as rational values
edge_cases: The pole example has zero and negative raw image denominators outside its valid domain. Guarded enumeration skips the empty clipped cells; negative image values are handled by integer floor followed by toNat.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.IntegerNeighbors
open TransposeFollowup

def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def shiftMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := -1; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def poleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := -2; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def coefficientMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1 / 2; b := 1 / 3; c := 1 / 5; d := 1; lo := -1 / 2; hi := 3 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outsideMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 2; hi := 3
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def cases : List RationalMobius :=
  [identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap, shiftMap, poleMap, coefficientMap, outsideMap]

def sameTests (F : RationalMobius) (n : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.finRange n).all (fun i => (List.finRange n).all (fun j =>
    F.integerOverlapTest i j == F.overlapTest i j))

def sameEndpoints (F : RationalMobius) (n : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.finRange n).all (fun i =>
    let l := F.leftPair i
    let r := F.rightPair i
    let L := F.imagePair l
    let R := F.imagePair r
    ((l.1 : Rat) / l.2 == F.sourceLeft i) &&
    ((r.1 : Rat) / r.2 == F.sourceRight i) &&
    ((L.1 : Rat) / L.2 == F.evalQ (F.sourceLeft i)) &&
    ((R.1 : Rat) / R.2 == F.evalQ (F.sourceRight i)))

#eval cases.map (fun F => (List.range 25).all (sameTests F))
#eval cases.map (fun F => (List.range 25).all (sameEndpoints F))
#eval (List.finRange 8).map (fun i => (poleMap.leftPair i, poleMap.imagePair (poleMap.leftPair i)))

def sameNeighbors (F : RationalMobius) (n : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.finRange n).all (fun i => F.integerNeighbors i == F.neighbors i)
#eval cases.map (fun F => (List.range 25).all (sameNeighbors F))
